name: OpenCode Zen
short: OpenCode's model gateway — 122 tracked models ship under `opencode/` ids, several with free tiers and a Go subscription plan.

plans.name: Free tier
plans.notes: Free IDs on selected models (e.g. Beam Free, Big Pickle, MiMo-V2.6-Flash Free); availability is labeled per model page. Since 2026-09-17 the free tier only works inside the OpenCode app/CLI — third-party harnesses get HTTP 403 (OpenCode team statement: github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/49587). Paid Zen and Go models are unaffected.

plans.name: OpenCode Go plan
plans.notes: Selected models are free under the Go plan (e.g. Cat Jam).

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Each covered model page links the rate claiming its price.
